title.value: BamQuery: a proteogenomic tool for the genome-wide exploration of the immunopeptidome
title.justification: The paper's title directly states its focus on a tool named BamQuery for exploring the immunopeptidome.
title.quote: BamQuery: a proteogenomic tool for the genome-wide exploration of the immunopeptidome

extractions.description: The paper presents BamQuery, a computational tool designed for the annotation-independent, genome-wide assessment of RNA expression onto MHC-I-associated peptides (MAPs) from RNA-sequencing data. It aids in identifying and mapping peptides derived from both canonical and non-canonical genomic regions, potentially improving the identification of tumor antigens for cancer immunotherapy.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on a computational tool for mapping the immunopeptidome and identifying tumor antigens, not on climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Quantifying canonical (exonic) and non-canonical MAPs-encoding RNA expression in malignant and benign cells is critical for identifying tumor antigens (TAs) but represents a challenge for immunologists.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address topics related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development explicitly; it focuses on cancer research and computational biology.
primary_category.quote: BamQuery can also help predict MAP immunogenicity and identify safe and actionable TAs.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no additional references to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development in the secondary implications of the paper.
secondary_categories.quote: The genome-wide approach of BamQuery allows comprehensive mapping of all MAPs in healthy and cancer tissues.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper is unrelated to specific sub-categories of Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development as it is focused on immunopeptidomic analysis for cancer research.
primary_sub_category.quote: BamQuery is a computational tool attributing an exhaustive RNA expression to MAPs of any origin (exon, intron, UTR, intergenic) from bulk and single-cell RNA-sequencing data.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No secondary sub-categories relevant to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development are present in the paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We present BamQuery, a computational tool for exploring the immunopeptidome.

applications.value: Identification of tumor antigens for cancer immunotherapy
applications.justification: The primary application of the BamQuery tool is the identification and prioritization of tumor antigens for purposes such as designing cancer immunotherapies.
applications.quote: BamQuery can also help predict MAP immunogenicity and identify safe and actionable TAs.

new_primary_category.justification: The predefined categories and sub-categories are not applicable to the paper's focus area, which is proteogenomics and cancer research.
new_primary_category.quote: The immunopeptidome is the repertoire of MHC-I-associated peptides (MAPs) that represents in real-time the landscape of the intracellular proteome.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no need to introduce a new sub-category as the topic does not fit into Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development areas.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Quantifying canonical (exonic) and non-canonical MAPs-encoding RNA expression in malignant and benign cells is critical for identifying tumor antigens (TAs) but represents a challenge for immunologists.
